title: Chapter 178: Attacking The Demon Clan Castle (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 178: Attacking The Demon Clan Castle (Part 2)

The Naga army and the Demon army were in a battle of horses and horses. The Naga did not attack this time, but allowed the Demon army to leave the city and arrange their troops.

If the Demon Clan is not allowed to have more troops, it will be the first to attack, and it will be easy to push the Demon Clan army back to the castle, which will directly turn into a siege battle.

The army in the rear is not ready yet and it is not appropriate to launch a siege.

The Naga army waited in formation for a long time, and the demon army came out with less than 300,000 troops. Naga felt that it was almost done, so she didn't wait any longer.

The nearly 500,000 elite troops of the Naga tribe can put up a good fight against the 300,000 demon tribe troops with continuous reinforcements from the castle behind.

Naga gave an order, and the heavy arrows of 150,000 Naga warriors were thrown at the demon army from a distance.

The Naga army knows that the Zerg puppies are good at close combat. They have prepared enough arrows this time and are ready to serve as a long-range unit.

This was the first time that the two tribes fought together under unified command.

The Zerg puppies were deployed on the front line and on both sides, firmly protecting the Naga warriors who were also good at melee combat as long-range attack units.

1,000 explosive mosquitoes fly into the sky and will wait for the opportunity.

Host No. 3 flies beside Nagaya to facilitate communication between the two races.

Nagaya no longer charged into the battle this time, but stood firmly in the middle of the army and became the commander-in-chief of the war.

Nagaron led all the one-star Naga warriors in the army to stand by.

When the demon army is fighting against the Naga tribe, when faced with long-range attacks, it is often a full-army assault. As long as it withstands a few rounds of heavy arrow damage, it can successfully draw the Naga tribe into close combat.

Warriors of the Naga tribe rarely serve as long-range attackers all the time. The professional long-range attack troops of the Naga tribe are all served by troops from other races.

These are the experiences summed up by the demon clan.

This time the Naga army only had Naga warriors and a large number of soldiers that the Demons had never seen before. The Demons still chose the same tactics as before, with an army of nearly 300,000 people swarming forward.

As long as the demon army rushes close to the Naga army, the lemure's melee combat combined with the flame demon's mid-range fireball attack, coupled with the elite dog demons, can overwhelm the Naga army.

Unfortunately, this time the Demon Tribe miscalculated. What they faced was not an ordinary Naga Tribe army, but a combination of the elite of the Tribe led by the Naga Tribe elders and the Zerg Puppies, the main force of Zerg melee combat.

When the demon army rushed up against the heavy rain of arrows from the Naga warriors, they faced Zerg puppies that were even more ferocious than them.

"Nagalon, go suppress the flame demon. Before the general attack, our losses cannot be too great!"

Nagaya ordered Nagaron to lead one-star Naga warriors into the formation, specifically responsible for suppressing the flame demons mixed in the lemures.

"Is it better for the Zerg to charge or defend?"

Nagaya asked Host No. 3 again.

"It doesn't matter!"

Wu Qing replied through Host No. 3.

"Then defend where you are and let the demons attack the defense line!"

"I have sent people to transport heavy arrows. This time I want to show the demons a different kind of Naga warriors!"

Nagaya found that Naga warriors and Zerg puppies cooperated to serve as long-range attack troops, which was very suitable. The long bows equipped by Naga warriors had a long range and great power, making them very good long-range weapons.

Only the warriors of the Naga tribe, as a melee unit, can have such luxury and equip all members with such powerful long-range weapons.

With the strength of the Naga warriors, they can shoot bows and arrows for a long time. With the protection of the Zerg puppies, they can rest calmly when they are tired.

"Then let's consume the demon clan's troops here first!"

Wu Qing thought the same way.

The demon clan's castle has too many troops, which is not conducive to a strong attack. If the demon clan is always willing to go out to fight in the city, then they can keep fighting like this and exhaust all their troops.

As non-professionals, the Naga warriors could not compare with the Zerg Hydralisks in the killing efficiency of long-range attacks. The demon army's lemure army quickly rushed to the front of the formation.

The lemure rushed to a place 20 to 30 meters in front of the Zerg puppy. The Zerg puppy, which had been standing still, suddenly rushed out and fought with the lemure that rushed up.

The Zerg puppy, which had already had one battle experience, had an easier time killing the lemures this time.

Originally, the combat power of the Zerg puppies was stronger than that of the lemures. In addition, they were familiar with the fighting methods of the lemures and had the most tacit teamwork. The lemures that just rushed up were basically slaughtered by the lemure puppies.

The lemures rushed to the front of the Naga formation, but they couldn't move at all. They themselves were still suffering a lot of losses. What's even more frightening is that the dead lemures couldn't even leave their bodies behind.

The Demon Tribe has realized how powerful the Zerg Puppies are, a new type of soldier, but they are powerful, and they are not invincible. The Demon Tribe has never been afraid of anyone on the battlefield.

There is an army of nearly 300,000 demons. They don’t believe they can’t break through the defense line of the Zerg puppies. If they can’t break through, then another 300,000 people will come. As long as the troops are sufficient, there is no defense line that the demons cannot break through.

Adhering to this idea, the Demon Clan does not need any new tactics. They just use the Demon Clan's three-blade ax to continuously attack the defense line composed of Zerg puppies and Naga warriors.

"Boom boom boom...!"

From time to time, fireballs from the flame demon fell into the formation of the Zerg puppies, disrupting the formation of the Zerg puppies.

Some dog demons also mixed in with the inferior demons, rushed to the front of the Zerg puppies, sprayed terrible flames, and relied on their powerful strength of at least one star to forcibly tear small holes in the defense line of the Zerg puppies.

The Zerg puppies are also very resistant to fire. They endure the extremely high temperature of the flames and rush to the dog demons without fear of life and death. Relying on the advantage of numbers, they surrounded and killed the dog demons.

Naga has been keeping a close eye on the situation on the front line. After discovering that many dog demons have joined the battle, she ordered the Naga warriors led by Naga Long to suppress the attack of the dog demons with special armor- piercing heavy arrows.

The number of Naga warriors is limited, and most of their attention is placed on the dog demons. The flame demons become arrogant, and more and more fireballs explode in the Zerg puppies.

"Come here! Pass my order! Transfer the feathered cavalry archers to me first!"

Naga felt that the long-range attacks of the Naga warriors were still not professional enough, so she sent people to dispatch professional long-range archers.

The most professional archer in the Naga territory is also a member of Yu Chong's tribe. With the Naga tribe's wealth, the Yu Clan archers here should be stronger than Yu Chong's territory in terms of equipment and number of troops.

The Yu Clan, a special race, is willing to work for the Naga tribe, which shows that the Naga tribe is good at governing the territory. For example, Yu Chong's territory is unwilling to work for the Tengu tribe.

The Naga city is not far away. Almost all the troops in the city have been mobilized. Now only the Yu Clan archers are sent to support, and the speed is very fast.

Not long after, a group of about 10,000 Yu Clan archers, riding on unique white unicorns, galloped over.

The Yu Clan leader who led the army galloped all the way to not far from Naga, turned over and dismounted, and went forward to listen to orders.

"You lead the tribe to support the front-line battle!"

"Focus on suppressing the dog demons and fire demons!"

Naga did not chat with the visitor and gave the order directly.

"Yes! Elder!"

The Feather Tribe leader turned and left, got on his horse, and led his troops into battle.

With the participation of professional and accurate archers like the Feather Tribe archers, the flame demons and dog demons in front will be hit accurately from a distance as long as they enter the range of the Naga army.

The Feather Tribe archers ride on tall mounts, and their vision is much better than that of the Naga warriors.

The Naga warriors can only use heavy arrows to shoot from a distance, while the sharp eyes of the Feather Tribe archers can find and lock on the dog demons and flame demons in the distant demon army, and launch accurate and effective attacks, with an attack efficiency higher than that of the one-star Naga warriors.

Wu Qing found that there were at least more than two thousand one-star archers among this Feather Tribe archers, and their strength was very strong.

Those one-star Feather Tribe archers could kill a flame demon with one arrow, and severely injure a dog demon with one arrow.

As soon as the Feather Clan archers came on the field, the dog demons in the demon army could no longer rush to the Zerg puppies, and the flame demons could only hide among the inferior demons and dared not attack at will.

The war continued!

The troops in the demon castle continued to go out of the city to support and join the attacking army to make up for the loss of troops in the front.

The troops in the Naga city were also constantly leaving the city. Many organized troops had rushed to the battlefield, but these troops had no orders from Naga and could only wait on the side and could not participate in the battle.

In addition to these troops, there were also many strange siege equipment such as catapults and multi-barreled siege crossbows that were also transported out of the city.

Wu Qing found that these equipment were all metal products, with many characteristics of goblin creations, and transportation was very convenient and fast.

The demons could clearly see the movements of the Naga city through the watchtower on the castle. When they saw that the Naga tribe had even moved out the large equipment that was previously only used for defending the city, they suddenly felt that the situation was a little out of control.

The battle under the city has been unsuccessful for a long time, and the enemy city is out in full force. The Naga tribe is ready for a decisive battle.

Even if they understand the Naga tribe's plan, the demon tribe is not afraid. They have decided to launch a full-scale attack on the Naga tribe in the next few days. Now the time is a little earlier, so it will not have much impact.

The Naga tribe took the initiative to go out of the city to fight this time, saving the trouble of attacking the city, which is good news.

Of course, the demon tribe is not stupid. They know that there must be something wrong when things are abnormal, and they are also strengthening the collection of various intelligence. At present, they have only found that there is an army of an unknown race in the Naga army, and they are now defending against the attack of the demon army on the front line.

Judging from the battlefield situation, the new soldiers found by the Naga tribe are indeed very powerful, but relying on this alone, they want to defeat the demon army stationed here. In the eyes of the demon tribe, this is impossible.

The confidence built up by the demon tribe in the long-term battle with the Naga tribe cannot be affected by an army of an unknown race.
